2. Heard Mr. S. Pattanaik, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Mr. P.K. Muduli,
learned Additional Government Advocate appearing for the State-opposite parties.
3.

The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking direction for payment of compensation for acquisition and occupation of the land to the extent of Ac.0.65 dec. pursuant to Annexure-6 for construction of microwave station and staff quarter by Railway Department of Khata No.93, Plot No.1706 in accordance with Section 24 (1) of LAR & R Act, 2013 on account of repeal of the Land Acquisition Act, 1984 and further to issue direction to opposite party no.2- Divisional Railway Manager, South Eastern Railway, Bilaspur or opposite party no.1-Union of India to publish a notification to the extent of the land illegally occupied and made construction over the same and accordingly determine and pay compensation as per LAR & R Act, 2013.

4. Mr. P.K. Muduli, learned Additional Government Advocate appearing for the State-opposite parties stated that opposite party no.5 has filed counter affidavit, paragraph-14 whereof states as follows:
"14.

That, in reply to the averments made in Paragraph-21 to 29 of the Writ Petition,
it is submitted that available record reveals that land acquisition proceeding initiated vide L.A. Case No.15/1968 under the provisions of L.A. Act, 1894 in respect of an area of Ac. 0.23 at Hemgir in the Village- Tangophar had already been dropped on 09.05.1977 as the said proceeding was invalid under the provision of L.A.

1 Amendment and validation Act, 1967.
Hence, no compensation award was made by the then L.A. Collector.
Therefore, question of payment of compensation doesn't arise.

Now the dispute is between the Writ Petitioners and the Authorities of S.E.
Railway, Bilaspur Division.

Further, it is s9ubmitted that the Divisional Railway Manager, S.E. Railway, Bilaspur Division, Chhattisgarh is in unauthorized occupation of private landed property of late Chhabila Pattanaik."
5.
In view of the above, since the land of the petitioner has not been acquired, question of payment of compensation does not arise.
However, if South Eastern Railway, Bilaspur Division is in possession of the land, the petitioner is permitted to pursue her remedy before the appropriate forum in accordance with law.
6. With the above observation, the writ petition stands disposed of.
